capabilities: Convert straight quotes into configurable typographic quotes as you type
Replace character sequences with user-defined rules (e.g. != to ≠)
Auto-pair characters and place the cursor between the pair
Add, edit, or remove replacement and pairing rules in settings
Skip code blocks, frontmatter, and other areas where changes are unwanted
motivation: The author created it to automate the use of smart quotes, custom text replacements, and auto-pairing of characters like guillemets.
problem: Obsidian's editor does not automatically apply typographic characters such as curly quotes or guillemets while you type, and offers no user-defined replacement or pairing rules.
summary: Typing-time typography enhancer that converts straight quotes to smart quotes, applies custom text replacements, and auto-pairs characters like guillemets.
